draft.title: Coordinator, Communications, Marketing, and Student Recruitment
draft.department: Office of Francophone and Francophile Affairs (OFFA)
draft.position_summary: Briefly describe the primary function and purpose of the position in one or two sentences. The Coordinator, Communications, Marketing, and Student Recruitment coordinates communications, marketing initiatives as well as student recruitment activities for the Office of Francophone and Francophile Affairs (OFFA). Under the direct supervision of the OFFA Director, the Coordinator participates in the planning and implementation of communications strategies; develops promotional materials; plans and participates in recruitment activities on and off campus for undergraduate and graduate programs offered in French and supported by OFFA in the Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences (FASS) and the Faculty of Education (FoE) at Simon Fraser University.

model.title: Coordinator, Communications and Student Recruitment
model.department: Office of Francophone and Francophile Affairs
model.position_summary: The Coordinator, Communications and Student Recruitment supports the Office of Francophone and Francophile Affairs by planning, developing and executing communications, marketing and recruitment initiatives that promote French‑language undergraduate and graduate programs in the Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences and the Faculty of Education. Working under the OFFA Director, the role creates promotional content, manages digital channels, provides prospective‑student guidance, and collaborates with internal and external partners to enhance visibility, attract diverse applicants and ensure alignment with university policies and strategic goals.
